items.title: Chuck Israels interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2021
items.q: not my friends but my parents’ friends were terribly threatened by that. Paul Robeson, Lester Cole who was one of the Hollywood Ten, Dalton Trumbo, people like that, Zero Mostel.

ctx.x: Do you think it’s getting worse?

I don’t know. It certainly seems to be threatening socio-politically at the moment. But at the same time that there are a lot of people who I think are succumbing to their prejudices I think we all have them. That was kind of my point is I think we all have them. And the question is not whether or not you have them but whether or not you succumb to them. As many people as there are that are succumbing to them, there’s also kind of a big group of people who say no, we don’t do that. It’s rather polarized and we…
Is that something, that feeling, is that something you would write music about?
